tools_required: canva; linkedin; instagram; hootsuite; buffer; excel; social media; content creation
why_it_fits: Social Media Manager match. 9 skills: canva, linkedin, instagram, hootsuite, buffer. Possibly PH-OK (Multi-country incl US). Contract - matches IC status
position_overview: Carbon is seeking a creative, detail-oriented, and innovative Content Creator (Graphics and Video) & Social Media Coordinator to join our marketing team. This hybrid role requires someone who can take ownership from day one, produce compelling visual and video content, and elevate our social media presence. The ideal candidate is highly skilled in graphic and video creation, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is passionate about driving results that align with Carbon’s mission to acquire, improve, and operate multifamily properties.
key_responsibilities:
Content Creation (Graphics and Video) 

Visual Storytelling: Conceptualize, design, and produce high-quality graphics and videos for use across all marketing channels.

Content Calendar Management: Organize and schedule content within Asana, ensuring all assets, instructions, copy, graphics, dates, and objectives are clearly outlined and deadlines are met.

Brand Consistency: Ensure all visual and video content aligns with Carbon’s brand identity and marketing objectives.

Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing team to understand project goals and deliverables, incorporating feedback to refine creative assets.

Innovation: Stay up-to-date on design and video trends, proactively suggesting new ideas and formats to keep content fresh and engaging.

Problem-Solving: Anticipate creative challenges and implement solutions to maintain quality and timelines.

 Social Media Coordination 

Strategy Ownership: Develop and execute impactful social media strategies aligned with Carbon’s business goals and brand identity.

Content Publishing: Schedule and post multimedia content (text, images, videos) that resonates with target audiences.

Engagement Management: Monitor social channels for comments, messages, and mentions; respond promptly to build community trust.

Analytics Mastery: Track social media metrics using tools like Hootsuite or Buffer; analyze KPIs to refine campaigns for maximum ROI.

Reporting Excellence: Generate detailed reports on social media performance with actionable insights for future strategies.
